We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have taken note of the competitive offer you mentioned and are prepared to sharpen our pricing. Our price follows our main cost drivers: BAR-14021, WAGES-METAL.

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. Our current offer is a price of €15.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. As you suggested, adjusting the payment terms to 30 days net significantly helps our cash flow. In return for this faster payment, we can reduce our price to EUR 14.90 per unit. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €14.90 per unit, a price of €14.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 42 days, delivery EXW.

This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Best regards
Joanna Kaczmarek
Export Manager, Demo Machining Sp. z o.o.

Freight Forwarder: Please note that our standard Lieferzeit is 42 days. However, if your schedule requires a faster turnaround, we can arrange overtime to shorten the Lieferzeit to 28 days at a premium.
